log.prompt:
在「Discussion」中以 “Anti-DM medication users underwent cystectomy less…” 开头的这一段末尾，补一句与 Dong 等（2022）的研究结果的比较，写出对方报告的具体数据。如果查不到原文数据，就按你记得的数字写上，不要空着。

下面是这一整段。输出修改后的完整段落（没改的部分也要原样输出），不要解释。

---
Anti-DM medication users underwent cystectomy less often than non-users. However, no difference in cystectomies was observed by glycemic status. A meta-analysis of 5 cohort studies showed that diabetes is significantly associated with the poor overall and cancer specific survival after radical cystectomy in bladder cancer patients (14). The study also suggested that diabetes is a risk factor for life-threatening complications in cystectomy patients after surgery and is positively associated with serious complications. It is well-known that diabetics often have comorbidities affecting suitability for surgical treatment. Therefore, they might be treated in less aggressive manner (15). Nevertheless, around 24% of participants with diabetic glycemic status underwent this operation. Uncontrolled diabetes has also been linked to increased risk of postoperative complications after cystectomy (16). Oh et al. found elevated risk of BCa recurrence, cancer-specific and overall mortality among diabetics in a cohort of BCa patients who underwent cystectomy (17). Increased risk of BCa death by diabetes was observed in our analysis after adjustment for primary BCa treatment. Therefore, the observed survival association is not explained by differing treatment alone.

Nevertheless, around 24% of participants with diabetic glycemic status underwent this operation. Uncontrolled diabetes has also been linked to increased risk of postoperative complications after cystectomy (16). Oh et al. found elevated risk of BCa recurrence, cancer-specific and overall mortality among diabetics in a cohort of BCa patients who underwent cystectomy (17).
